福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安南區

台江十六寮與海尾朝皇宮Taijiang Settlements & Haiwei Temple

歡迎來到安南。1823 年後泥沙填滿台江內海，移民在新生地上搭起草寮。這裡長滿菅芒，所以被叫作「菅仔埔」。1878 年，海尾寮居民建了海尾朝皇宮，主祀醫神保生大帝。它的宋江陣遠近馳名：「未曾看過海尾斧，也要聽過海尾鼓」！2019 年台江文化中心開幕，玻璃帷幕的靈感來自昔日沙洲上的菅芒花。它的廣場就像廟埕，為整個社區而建。

Welcome to Annan. After 1823, silt filled the Taijiang Inland Sea, and settlers built grass huts on the new land. Silvergrass grew everywhere, so the land was called Jianzaipu, the silvergrass field. In 1878, Haiwei villagers built Haiwei Chaohuang Temple for Baosheng Dadi, the god of medicine. Its Songjiang troupe is famous: never seen the Haiwei axe? You must have heard the Haiwei drum! In 2019, the Taijiang Cultural Center opened, with glass walls inspired by silvergrass on the old sandbars. Its plaza is like a temple square, built for the whole community. Let's explore!

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

安南區原本是台江內海。內海淤積後，移民在新生地上搭起草寮，形成「台江十六寮」。海尾朝皇宮的宋江陣遠近馳名，2019 年開幕的台江文化中心則是社區的新廟埕。

Annan District was once the Taijiang Inland Sea. When it silted up, settlers built grass huts on the new land. Haiwei Chaohuang Temple is famous for its martial-arts troupe, and the Taijiang Cultural Center is the community's new gathering place.

  1. 1823 後 After 1823曾文溪改道，泥沙填滿內海，移民開墾新生地。The Zengwen River shifts, silt fills the sea, and settlers farm the new land.
  2. 1878海尾寮居民建海尾朝皇宮，主祀保生大帝。Villagers build Haiwei Chaohuang Temple for the god of medicine.
  3. 1946取安順與臺南各一字，命名安南。The district is named Annan.
  4. 2019台江文化中心開幕。The Taijiang Cultural Center opens.

認識景點

About the place

草寮：移民在新生地上搭起草寮。 台江十六寮：「台江十六寮」泛指今天安南區的聚落。 菅芒：長滿這片土地，所以叫「菅仔埔」。 淤積：1823 年曾文溪改道，泥沙填滿了內海。

grass hut: Settlers built grass huts, called liao, on the new land. Sixteen Liao: is the old name for the villages of Annan. silvergrass: Silvergrass covered the land, so it was called Jianzaipu. silt: In 1823, the Zengwen River shifted and filled the inland sea with silt.

安南：1946 年，取「安順」的安與「臺南」的南，合稱安南。 台江國家公園：在 2009 年成立。 海尾朝皇宮：創建於 1878 年。 保生大帝：醫神保生大帝，人們叫他「海尾大道公」。

Annan: In 1946, An from Anshun and Nan from Tainan made the name Annan. Taijiang National Park: was set up in 2009. Haiwei Chaohuang Temple: was founded in 1878. Baosheng Dadi: the god of medicine, is called the Haiwei Dadaogong.

宋江陣：源自早期聚落防禦外敵的武術操練。 鼓：未曾看過海尾斧，也要聽過海尾鼓！ 斧頭：宋江陣會拿斧頭等兵器。 遶境：每三年，神明會遶境巡行村莊。

Songjiang troupe: The Songjiang troupe began as martial-arts drills to defend the village. drum: Never seen the Haiwei axe? You must have heard the Haiwei drum! axe: The Songjiang troupe carries weapons such as axes. procession: Every three years, the gods tour the village in a procession.

建醮：每六年，廟方舉行盛大的建醮。 社區大學：2006 年，社區大學台江分校設在廟裡。 飛虎將軍：1944 年一名飛行員把著火的戰機駛離村落，居民尊他為「飛虎將軍」。 台江文化中心：在 2019 年開幕。

Jiao ceremony: Every six years, the temple holds a great Jiao ceremony. community college: In 2006, a community college opened inside the temple. Flying Tiger General: In 1944, a pilot steered his burning plane away from the village. Locals honored him as the Flying Tiger General. Taijiang Cultural Center: The Taijiang Cultural Center opened in 2019.

玻璃帷幕：的意象，來自昔日沙洲上的菅芒花。 台江埕：戶外廣場「台江埕」源自傳統廟埕的概念。 老樹：建築順應並保留了三棵老樹。 圖書館：在半地下的樓層，旁邊是開放廣場。

glass curtain wall: The glass walls recall silvergrass on the old sandbars. temple-square plaza: The outdoor plaza follows the idea of a temple square. old tree: The building was planned around three old trees. library: The library sits in a half-underground level beside an open plaza.

實景照片

Photos on site

台江文化中心 Taijiang Cultural Center

台江文化中心的外牆包著一層銀白色的金屬網，交錯的線條像樹枝和葉脈。門前的廣場常有表演：這一天，舞者穿著紅色長袖舞衣在台上甩袖起舞，背板寫著「虎年走春來台江」，是過年期間的走春活動。

The Taijiang Cultural Center is wrapped in a silver metal screen whose crossing lines look like branches and leaf veins. The plaza in front often hosts shows. On this day, dancers in red robes swung their long sleeves on stage during a Lunar New Year event.

散步路線

Walking route

需開車或搭車 By car or bus在臺南市區外，需要開車或搭車前往。
It is outside central Tainan, so you will need a car, bus or taxi.
